RAW_CLAIM.raw_claim_key: stable id of one agent utterance (NEVER deleted, even after merge)
evidence_refs: source_id ... the agent cited (REQUIRED; empty => NOT_KNOWLEDGE)

CANONICAL_PROPOSITION.canonical_key: stable id of the merged proposition
raw_claim_keys: raw_claim_key ... merged into this proposition (preserved lineage back to raw)
evidence_refs: union of source_ids across merged raw claims
provenance_roots: root_id ... resolved via PROVENANCE_SCHEMA ancestry graph
CANONICAL_PROPOSITION.falsifier: the strongest concrete disconfirming observation for this proposition

invariants: raw_claim_key set is append-only; canonicalization never deletes raw claims.
a canonical proposition with empty evidence_refs is NOT_KNOWLEDGE and cannot contribute to N_E.
signal_type/buying_signal are descriptive tags, NOT admission; HAL_result SURVIVED != TRUE != ADMITTED.
provenance_independence_status defaults to UNKNOWN until ancestry is established (fail-closed on independence).
